The town of Herndon became completely cutoff and surrounded by flood waters. These flash flood waters also put a levee upstream of the town to become at risk of failing, which would have flooded the town. Thankfully, the levee held and was able to be reinforced in the afternoon hours. North of Ludell, at least one country road culvert was completely washed out, making the road impassable.
